name: home-tab-plus
description: Your vault, from the first tab — a browser-like home tab with instant file search, starred and recent files, and an optional interactive particle wordmark.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/copy-styles.mjs
scripts.build:local: pnpm run build && pnpm run copy-to-local
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Renso
